queries.cypher: MATCH (pr:PR) WHERE pr.id = $r OR pr.id ENDS WITH $s RETURN pr.id, pr.createdAt, pr.state, pr.title LIMIT 3

MATCH (f:File) WHERE f.id IN $files MATCH (p:Person)-[r:AUTHORED|REVIEWED]->(pr:PR)-[:TOUCHES]->(f) WHERE pr.createdAt < $asof AND p.login <> $author RETURN p.login, sum((CASE type(r) WHEN 'REVIEWED' THEN $wr ELSE $wa END) * exp(-($asof - pr.createdAt) / $tau)) AS s
MATCH (a:Person {login: $author})-[:AUTHORED]->(pr:PR)<-[:REVIEWED]-(p:Person) WHERE pr.createdAt < $asof AND p.login <> $author RETURN p.login, sum(exp(-($asof - pr.createdAt) / $tau)) AS s
MATCH (:User {id:$u})-[a:AVOID]->(p:Person) WHERE a.until > $now RETURN p.login, a.scope, a.reason, a.pr, a.until

MATCH (p:Person {login:$u})-[r:AUTHORED|REVIEWED]->(pr:PR)-[:TOUCHES]->(f:File) WHERE f.id IN $files AND pr.createdAt < $asof WITH pr, type(r) AS role, count(f) AS shared RETURN pr.id, pr.title, role, shared ORDER BY shared DESC, pr.createdAt DESC LIMIT 2
